verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a self-service path — free CRM signup with no expiration, self-service data transfer/import for multiple objects, automatic deduplication, and workflow creation — all achievable without a partner (hubspot-docs-7,9,25,27,29,8,10,12). However, no evidence quantifies time-to-value or confirms a real founder can reach a 'working pipeline with real data' inside one hour; community commentary only addresses marketing/product perception, not onboarding speed. Missing for 10: a documented or independent time-to-pipeline benchmark, and hands-on confirmation that import+dedup+workflow setup is fast enough for non-technical founders without support.
